IMPLEMENTATION RULES:
1. Implement the issue FULLY — nothing unfinished
2. Follow existing codebase patterns exactly
3. Use **jj** for all version control, never git

5. If modifying Go code: run `make test-go` and fix any failures
6. If modifying CLI code: run type checks
7. Atomic commits with clear messages
8. Pre-existing test failures count — fix those too

CODE QUALITY:
